skills.detail:
When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
Moves you to your team's closest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy. A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect that inflicts a SPD debuff.

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: You're Safe Now!!

skills.detail: A long-range charge attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Recovery Block. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Enough of that!!
